on_screen.condition: Dress soaked by heavy rain, with muddy splashes around the hem; socks and shoes wet. Hair slicked by rain but still secured in its bun. Kneels beside the canal and touches Nimal's hand.
on_screen.why: First on-screen appearance, at dawn with her medical bag; retain her base nursing clothes.

on_screen.condition: Lies still beside the canal gate, eyes closed. Shirt and trousers soaked and marked with canal silt; sleeves remain rolled to the elbows. Hair wet and flattened. One fist closed around a small metal key.
on_screen.why: Retains the clothes last seen at the garage, despite the overnight interval.
